main.description: Indexes and searches one collection for an org, and says how. Lives in the org's `members` space, authored by the org DID, keyed by the collection's NSID. A collection with no record here is not indexed or searched, unless it is a default collection; a record for a default collection overrides its default config. What a record omits keeps its default.

users.description: Where the people a record is about come from, for filtering. Defaults to the record's owner; an empty list sets none.

date.description: Where the record's date comes from, for filtering and sorting. Defaults to the record's updatedAt, else its createdAt; null sets none.

fields.description: The fields to index. When omitted, every string in the record is searchable and nothing is filterable or sortable; when set, unlisted fields are not indexed.

blobs.description: Whether the text of the blobs a record references is searchable. Defaults to true.

path.description: A dotted path into the record, with [] for each element of an array, such as tags[].name.

searchable.description: Makes the field's text searchable, ranked by weight. Normal text is split into chunks.

type.description: What the field's values are read as for filtering and sorting; values of another type are skipped.

slot.description: Where a filterable or sortable number or datetime, or a sortable string, is stored. Fixed once set, and not shared by two fields.

fieldSource.description: Values from a path into the record, as field paths.

metadataSource.description: A value from the record's metadata rather than its value.

name.description: owner is the DID of the repo the record is in.
